verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents that Unleash server/backend SDKs evaluate flags locally from a cached ruleset without a network call per check. The closest material describes Unleash Edge, a separate caching layer that evaluates flags for frontend SDKs on the Edge node. That is an adjacent component, not in-process server SDK evaluation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, my server SDKs evaluate flags locally from a cached ruleset — microsecond decisions with no network call per flag check

citations.quote: It evaluates feature flags for [frontend SDKs](/sdks#frontend-sdks) directly on the Edge node
